comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar. THE DISCRIMINATING CASE for the self-rental rule (Reg. 1.469-2(f)(6)): property A is a 12,000 self-rental profit (Schedule E line 1b type 7) whose lessee business the filer materially participates in, so that profit is recharacterized NON-PASSIVE and leaves the Form 8582 pool; property B's 6,000 passive loss then has nothing to be set against and suspends. Line 9 is 48,250 + 12,000 = 60,250. Taxable 60,250 - 15,750 = 44,500; tax 5,105 = table(44,525 midpoint) = 1,192.50 + 12% of 32,600 = 5,104.50; overpaid 6,000 - 5,105 = 895. Answer the lessee question NO on the same pair and the profit stays passive, absorbs B's loss and serves 54,250 / 4,385 / 1,615 - 720 of tax turning on one answer, asserted in test_contract.py. B's active_participation FALSE is load-bearing: with a Yes the 25,000 special allowance takes B's loss either way and the pair stops discriminating. Until this unit a self_rental property type was refused before mapping, so this return got no lines at all.
